title: First check in a new project on a Mac fails: no timeout
what: The template bounds a run without the timeout program: use timeout, else gtimeout, else a python or perl wrapper that kills the process after N seconds (exit 124 as now); also check md5sum (used for --tests) exists or use a portable hash.
why: bin/check calls timeout, which macOS does not have, so the first check fails as if a test failed and a round of the 3-round budget is spent; with a local shim there is no hang bound at all.
failing_case: Trial: in a fresh project made by relay setup, bin/check printed 'timeout: command not found' and exited 1 on the first run; the trial had to patch in a shim that removes the hang bound.
pass_cases: On a machine with no timeout or gtimeout, bin/check on a green project prints passed (exit 0) and on a hanging step prints HUNG within CHECK_TIMEOUT.
